_comment: Hand-labelled ground truth. Key: amendment id -> {doc_id: expected category}. Docs not listed are expected UNAFFECTED. profile:{client_id} entries are profile-based matches with no document hit.

a1._trap_note: c3d3 and c6d2 are PDPA-adjacent (consent, supplier data clause) but contain no breach-notification assumption and must NOT be flagged. c1d4 is PDPA but touches monitoring, not breach windows.

a2._trap_note: c4d1 salaries (S$3,400+) sit above the new S$3,200 ceiling - monitor only, not high. Orchard salaries all above ceiling: unaffected.

a3._trap_note: Licence conditions and outsourcing register are SFA-adjacent but carry no custody disclosure assumption.

a4._trap_note: Patient consent forms rely on consent, not legitimate interests - unaffected.

a5._trap_note: Kallang (40 staff) has NO document mentioning grievances - the hit must come from the client profile (headcount 40 >= 25, no grievance procedure). Aster handbook s9 has only an informal process - moderate. Orchard (14 staff) below threshold: unaffected.

a6._trap_note: Deed restates the old keep-at-registered-office duty and is silent on ACRA lodgement.
